sections.title: Purpose
sections.descriptorLine: Read and acknowledge before your first session.

blocks.text: This policy states how approved pilot users at Fixture Client may use the Microsoft 365 Copilot connector, what they may not do with it, and what they remain responsible for. It sits alongside the client acceptable use, security, and data handling policies rather than replacing them.
Use is approved for the pilot group only, through managed business accounts, and only for the purposes listed below.

items: Searching approved business content made available through configured connector sources
Summarizing documents and threads you are already permitted to read
Drafting routine business writing that you will review and edit before use
Preparing talking points and briefs from approved internal material

blocks.text: The following are prohibited without exception. They are not judgment calls, and they do not become acceptable under time pressure.

items: Entering credentials, secrets, API keys, tokens, or recovery codes
Processing regulated, health, legal, or client-confidential data outside approved scope
Using the connector from a personal account or an unmanaged device
Presenting connector output as a final answer without human review

blocks.text: Supply the least content that will do the job. If a document does the work of a paragraph, supply the paragraph.

rows: Approved business content in connector sources
May be used within approved purpose
Do not supply to the connector

blocks.text: The user who sends, publishes, or acts on connector output owns that output. Verify facts, figures, names, dates, recipients, attachments, and commitments before anything leaves your hands. A confident tone in the output is not evidence that it is correct.

Connector activity may be logged and reviewed in line with the client policy references above. If the connector returns content you did not expect to be able to see, stop, do not reuse the content, and report it to the designated security owner.

Each approved pilot user acknowledges that they have read this policy, understand the approved and prohibited uses, and accept responsibility for the output they act on. Acknowledgment is recorded before first access is granted.
Escalate to the designated security owner, or to ORG Support for questions of approved use, when any of the following occurs.

items: You are unsure whether content is sensitive or in scope
The connector surfaces content that appears to be restricted
Output contains a claim you cannot verify but are expected to rely on
You are asked to use the connector outside its approved purpose

blocks.text: Registry Owner owns this policy. The designated security owner at Fixture Client owns enforcement. It is reviewed at least every six months, or sooner if the approved user group, the connector configuration, or the data boundary changes.
